scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official Newsroom was checked on 15 October 2026. Its newest featured creative/marketing item remains 'Why intention matters more than attention' from 13 October; the Beauty Trend Report remains dated 6 October. Q5 and festive campaign guidance were rechecked and add no durable capability beyond the existing catalogue. Two public Pinterest inspiration-board endpoints returned HTTP 403, and Pinterest search was not accessible, so no trend was inferred from unavailable board content.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.22.0 with 718 commands was read before evaluation. No materially useful non-duplicate command change was identified. All 718 commands, 42 categories, 40 executable bundle mappings, settings, personal creative intelligence and Firefox updater controls remain byte-for-byte unchanged; 18 regression checks passed.
trends: Intent-led creative should move people from discovery to confidence, decision and action; this remains fully represented by /intent-to-action
Beauty specificity, reference decoding and coordinated editorial/product/UGC variants remain represented by /beauty-trend-system
Q5 utility and self-purchase reframing remain covered by /intent-to-action, /trend-to-brand and existing campaign controls
Multi-format performance breadth and five-plus distinct creative variants remain covered by /performance-creative-mix
No official Pinterest creative or design report newer than 13 October 2026 was present at scan time
skipped: No new command for the intention economy because /intent-to-action already operationalizes customer progress, proof, friction removal, next-step CTAs and progress-oriented measurement
No Q5-specific command because its durable utility and self-purchase behaviors are already composable from /intent-to-action, /trend-to-brand and existing campaign commands
No Beauty microtrend aliases because /beauty-trend-system already captures precise placement, finish, palette, intensity, reference decoding and output variants
No additional performance-ad command because /performance-creative-mix already encodes genuine format and concept breadth with a testing plan
No command was derived from public Pinterest boards or Pinterest search pages that were inaccessible during this run
